verdict.rationale: Nitrokey publishes public documentation, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. Direct probes found no llms.txt and no markdown doc variants (both HTTP 404). The NetHSM OpenAPI/Swagger spec is a machine-readable API description, which is adjacent material and not agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
